title: The glass-ash wraith actively pursued across three separate room-changes, dealing armor-piercing damage each turn, unlike every other 'attacks on sight' creature met (wolves, boar, hollow gleaner, honour guard), which stay confined to their own room. Nothing signals this creature has a different, larger aggro range before it happens.
where: The Slag Heaps (Emberfall) / retreat north/east after the wraith attacks
